title: Pocketwire Rewards Long-Service Table for the Quarterly Milestone Bonus
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members with at least 3 whole years of membership receive the milestone tenure supplement on a quarterly milestone bonus.

## Rule

The milestone tenure supplement is 2500 points when the membership has completed at least 5 whole years, 1200 points when it has completed at least 3 but fewer than 5 whole years, and nothing when it has completed fewer than 3 whole years. The supplement is added to the quarterly milestone bonus credited, in whole points.

The membership's whole years are the whole months from the enrolment date to the handling date divided by twelve and rounded down.

## Supplement by whole years

| Whole years of membership on the handling date | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 2500 points |
| 3 or 4 | 1200 points |
| 0 to 2 | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Enrolled 58 whole months before the handling date: 58 divided by twelve is 4.83, rounded down to 4 whole years; 1200 points.
- Enrolled 60 whole months before: 5 whole years; 2500 points.
- Enrolled 35 whole months before: 2 whole years; nothing.
